entities.summary: Sambhaji, also known as Shambhuraje, was the second king of the Maratha Empire from 1681 to 1689. He played a crucial role in the empire's expansion and consolidation during the early modern period. Sambhaji's reign was marked by his efforts to strengthen the empire's military and administrative structures, as well as his attempts to promote trade and commerce. His legacy continued to shape the Maratha Empire's trajectory in the centuries that followed.
